truth_boundary: This plan records branch hygiene only. It does not claim PIE/device/visual acceptance.

preserve.reason: canonical interactive/integration lane and programmer handoff source

safety_rules: Never delete an active PR head.
Delete a branch immediately after its meaningful content is merged into develop.
Every cleanup run automatically enumerates live remote refs and deletes non-protected branches only when GitHub reports zero commits ahead of develop.
delete_after_merge is an explicit deletion supplement, not the sole source of dead-branch discovery.
Never bulk-merge or auto-delete a divergent branch with unique commits; selectively salvage or explicitly supersede it first.
Branches with unresolved unique commits remain protected until reviewed.
Cleanup runs only from an exact-head develop checkout.
